as_told.title: Von Neumann starts lecturing on self-replicating machines after Roswell

plain: The mathematician John von Neumann is said to have suddenly begun talking about machines that can build copies of themselves, now called von Neumann machines, in 1948, one year after Roswell, the 1947 New Mexico incident where many say a crashed flying saucer was recovered. The researcher Deep Prasad says that before then von Neumann's lectures had nothing to do with such ideas, and then he was talking about them like it was his job. Another, unnamed guest on the same episode says the same, adding 1949. On an episode titled AI Is ALIEN Technology, the timing is offered as a hint that the idea came from studying something recovered at Roswell.
